roles.Q1: Determinant: why reindustrialization varies (a cause of the variation)
roles.Q2: Effect: what a variant does (an outcome of the variation)
roles.TYPOLOGY: Defines or classifies a variant, without a cause or effect
roles.OTHER: Relevant context that fits none of the above

direction_rule: Direction is the sign of change in the NAMED outcome quantity, never good or bad. '+' = the quantity named in 'outcome' rises. '-' = it falls. 'mixed' = it rises in one place or time and falls in another. 'none' = no change, or the authors did not assess it. Example: SOE losses grow -> outcome 'fiscal and financial burden', direction '+'. Privatization cuts the state deficit -> same outcome, direction '-'.
expected_rule: expected = true when the quote is a forecast, an expectation, a hypothetical ('may', 'likely', 'if... then'), a stated limit of the study, or a view the authors report without testing. Such a claim keeps its role (Q2 if it names an outcome) and gets expected = true. expected = false for measured or observed findings.
pathway_rule: Tag pathway from what THIS quote says about a mechanism or case, not from the topic of the whole paper. Use [] when the quote names no variant. A book or paper about one pathway does not make every claim carry that pathway.
q1_factors: state capacity and existing coordination institutions
executive consolidation of power / regime type
position in world economy (FDI, commodity dependence, core-periphery)
external policy space (trade rules, great-power pressure)
local developmental agency and cooperation (local government, firms, universities)
physical and human-capital infrastructure (transport, skills, universities)
governance of the state's own firms (selection of managers, transparency, political appointment)
depth of local capital markets and finance
